origin.says: 共 (two hands offering) as the sound plus ⺗ (heart, a form of 心): a respectful heart, reverent, polite.

衰.def: weak, feeble; to decline, to falter

ety.hint: A person in a robe 衣 with an injury 一 to his head 口

origin.says: One reading: a picture of a raincoat of palm fibres (first form of 蓑, straw cape), a 衣 (garment) with the fibres in the middle. 'Weak, declining' is a later use.

衰.name: decline

杜.def: to prevent, to restrict, to stop; surname

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 土 (earth) as the sound: first a kind of wild pear tree; its sense 'to block, prevent' is a borrowing. Also a surname.

杜.name: block off

origin.says: 米 (rice) for the meaning plus 卒 (soldier) as the sound: pure, unmixed grain, so pure, essence.
者 as the sound plus 灬 (fire) for the meaning: to cook over a fire, to boil.
隹 (bird) for the meaning plus 牙 (tooth) as the sound: first a variant of 鴉 (crow), then borrowed for 'elegant, refined'.

沈.def: to sink, to submerge; addicted; surname

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 冘 as the sound: to sink; now mostly the surname Shen. It also stands for 瀋 (juice), which had 審 as its sound part.

沈.name: submerge

origin.says: 皮 (skin) as the sound plus 页 (head) for the meaning: first a tilted head, so 'biased', later 'rather, quite'. Simplified from 頗, with 頁 (head) written 页.
石 (stone) for the meaning plus 卑 (lowly) as the sound: an upright stone tablet with an inscription, a gravestone or monument.

扑.def: to attack, to beat, to hit, to strike

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 卜 (divine) as the sound: to strike. Simplification adopted it for 撲 (to pounce, to beat), which had a complex sound part.

扑.name: pounce

origin.says: A modern coinage: 气 (gas) for the meaning plus 羊, short for 養 (nourish), as the sound: the gas that keeps life going, oxygen.

夹.def: to support; to be wedged between

ety.hint: A person 夫 stuck between two others 丷

origin.says: A person 大 (big man) with two small 人 (people) at the sides: something pressed from both sides. Simplified from 夾 in cursive style, so the side people became two short strokes.

夹.name: sandwich

origin.says: A new simplified form for 叢 (a cluster), whose old build was unrelated. It is 从 (follow) as the sound with a stroke 一 (ground) added to tell it apart: people or plants crowded on the ground.

漏.def: to leak, to drip; hour glass; funnel

ety.hint: Water 氵 falling like raindrops 雨; 屚 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 氵 (water) plus 屚 (rain under a roof: a leak), which also gives the sound: water leaking, dripping; also the water clock.

漏.name: drip

origin.says: 米 (rice) for the meaning plus 立 (stand) as the sound: a grain of rice, any small granule.
Simplified from 瀏: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 劉 (Liu) as the sound, written 刘: clear, swift-flowing water; now used in 'to browse'.
土 (earth) for the meaning plus 襄 (assist) as the sound: soft, rich soil.

ety.hint: Freshly-cut 新 wood 艹; 新 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 艹 (plants) for the meaning plus 新 (new) as the sound: firewood, the original meaning of 新; later also pay, as in salary.

遣.def: to send, to dispatch; to exile, to send off

origin.says: Originally two hands giving orders over a troop sign: to send an army. 辶 (walking) was added later. The top parts reshaped into 𠀐 and 㠯.

遣.name: dispatch

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 彭 (drumbeat) as the sound: flesh that swells up, bloated.
合 (join, close with a lid) as the sound, which also fits, over 皿 (vessel) for the meaning: a small box with a lid.

摔.def: to fall, to stumble, to trip

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 率 (lead) as the sound: to fling down, and to fall down hard.

摔.name: fall down

摘.def: to pick, to pluck, to select, to take

ety.hint: To pick 扌 a fruit off a branch 啇

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 啇 (root) as the sound: to pick or pluck by hand, to select.

摘.name: pluck fruit

origin.says: A drawing of a crescent moon, the same picture as 月 (moon) with one stroke less: the moon rising, hence evening.

夕.name: dusk
夕.in: 多将外名够岁罗移奖梦舞逻怨瞬蒋碗爹酱萝腕侈铭浆桨惋哆啰苑宛鸳秽婉锣箩豌磷鳞

肌.def: flesh, skin; muscle, tissue; meat on bones

origin.says: 月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 几 (small table) as the sound: flesh, muscle, skin.

肌.name: muscle

娶.def: to marry, to take a wife

ety.hint: To take 取 a wife 女; 取 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 取 (take) as the sound and the sense plus 女 (woman): to take a wife.

娶.name: take a wife

ety.hint: A younger brother 尗 killed in a war 戈

origin.says: 戊 (a battle-axe) for the meaning plus 尗 (beans) as the sound: first an axe, later borrowed for relatives and for sorrow.
讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 枼 (leaf) as the sound: to spy, a secret report. Simplified from 諜 (言 written 讠).

晕.def: dizzy, faint, foggy; to see stars

origin.says: 日 (sun) for the meaning plus 军 (army) as the sound: the halo ringing the sun, then a swimming head, dizzy. The earliest form drew the sun with lines around it. Simplified from 暈.

晕.name: dizzy halo

拆.def: to break open, to split up, to tear apart

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 斥 (scold) as the sound: to tear apart by hand, to dismantle.

拆.name: tear down

origin.says: Simplified from 惱: 忄 (heart) for the meaning plus a right part that is the sound, being vexed. The simplified form replaces that right part with 㐫.

胖.def: fat, plump, obese; a fat person

origin.says: 月 (here flesh) for the meaning plus 半 (half) as the sound. It once meant half a sacrificial animal's body; the sense 'fat, plump' came later.
origin.src: Wiktionary; Dong Chinese; own knowledge for the old sense

胖.name: plump

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 喿 (chirping) as the sound. It first meant to wash the hands, later to bathe.
斗 (ladle) for the meaning plus 余 (surplus) as the sound: to scoop out with a tilted ladle, hence slanting, diagonal.

ety.hint: Many suns 日, suggesting a bright and glittering gem

origin.says: Three 日 (sun) together: many bright points of light, hence sparkling, crystal.

纺.def: to spin, to weave, to reel

origin.says: 纟 (silk thread) for the meaning plus 方 (square) as the sound: to spin thread. Simplified from 紡, with 糹 in its short form 纟.

纺.name: spin

牢.def: pen, prison, stable; fast, firm, secure

ety.hint: A stable 宀 where cattle are kept 牛

origin.says: 宀 (here a pen or animal yard) around 牛 (cow): a pen for cattle, then a prison; also firm, secure.

牢.name: cattle pen

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 炎 (blaze) as the sound: watery, weak in taste, pale.
交 (to cross) as the sound plus 阝 (town, from 邑): the land around a city, the outskirts.

ety.hint: Water flowing 人 from a spring 口 through a valley 八

origin.says: Draws a valley: an opening 口 (mouth) below lines for the mountain walls on both sides. It also took over 穀 (grain) in simplified writing.

谷.name: valley
谷.in: 容欲俗浴裕溶熔豁蓉榕

origin.says: Simplified from 瑪 (agate): 𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 馬 (horse) as the sound, shortened to 马.

巡.def: to cruise, to inspect, to patrol

ety.hint: To walk 辶 by the river 巛; 巛 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 川 (river), written here as 巛, as the sound: to go round, to patrol.

巡.name: make rounds

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 厷 (upper arm) as the sound: a deep, echoing house, hence vast and grand.
犭 (dog) for the meaning plus a sound part: hunting with dogs. The full form 獵 had 巤 (bristly mane) as the sound; the simplified form swaps it for 昔 (former times), of similar sound.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 匡 (square basket) as the sound, which also suggests a box shape: a wooden door frame, a frame.

ety.hint: To talk 日 like a fish 鱼

origin.says: Originally 魚 (fish) plus 口 (mouth), first meaning fine, excellent, perhaps a tasty fish; the mouth later merged into a shape like 日 (sun). Another reading takes the bottom as a sound part. Now the state of Lu, and dull, rash.

骚.def: to annoy, to bother; to disturb, to harrass

ety.hint: A flea 蚤 biting a horse 马; 蚤 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 蚤 (flea) as the sound: a restless horse, hence to disturb, to harass. The sense sad, grieved is a borrowing. Simplified from 騷.

骚.name: harass

origin.says: 舟 (boat) for the meaning plus a sound part: a warship. Simplified from 艦, whose sound part 監 (oversee) was replaced by the similar-sounding 见 (see).

ety.hint: The thunderous sound of a pair 双 of carts 车

origin.says: Simplified from 轟, three 車 (cart) together: the thunder of many carts, hence a rumble or blast. The simplified form keeps one 车 and writes the lower two as 双 (pair).

ety.hint: Someone 亻 who lectures 尃; 尃 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 尃 (spread out) as the sound: a person who assists and teaches, a tutor.
Simplified from 銳: 金 (metal, shortened to 钅) for the meaning plus 兑 (exchange) as the sound: a sharp point, keen.
亻 (person) plus 山 (mountain), which also gives the sound: a person who goes into the mountains to become immortal. It replaced the older 僊.
Simplified from 驟: 馬 (horse) became 马. 马 (horse) for the meaning plus 聚 (gather) as the sound: a galloping horse, hence 'sudden, abrupt'.

ety.hint: A spoon 匕 aimed for the mouth 日

origin.says: 匕 (spoon) going into a mouth, the bottom now written 日 (sun): first meaning delicious, then aim or purpose. Another reading takes 匕 as the sound with 甘 (sweet) below.

ety.hint: An army officer carrying a weapon 刂 and a flag 巾

origin.says: Simplified from 帥: two hands pulling (later read as 𠂤 (heap)) beside 巾 (cloth, a banner): one who leads, a commander, now also handsome. The left part is shortened to two strokes.

ety.hint: All 共 the water 氵; 共 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 共 (together) as the sound: a great flood, hence vast.

抹.def: to apply; to erase, to smear, to wipe off

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 末 (tip, end) as the sound: to smear or wipe with the hand, to apply or erase.

抹.name: rub on

origin.says: 艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 匋 (pottery-making) as the sound. Used only in 葡萄 (grape), a word taken from a Central Asian language, so the characters were picked for their sound.
艹 (plant) for the meaning plus 匍 (to crawl) as the sound. With 萄 it spells a foreign word for grape, brought from Central Asia; earlier written 蒲陶. Now also Portugal.

讽.def: sarcastic; to chant, to mock, to ridicule

origin.says: Simplified from 諷: 言 (speech) for the meaning plus 風 (wind) as the sound: to chant, then to mock in words; both parts simplified (讠, 风).

讽.name: mock

唉.def: alas; exclamation of surprise or pain

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 矣 (old particle) as the sound: the sound of a sigh, alas.

唉.name: alas

origin.says: 宀 (roof) for the meaning plus 莫 (do not) as the sound: a silent, empty house, lonely.

浴.def: to bathe, to shower, to wash

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 谷 (valley) as the sound: washing the body in water, to bathe.

浴.name: bathe

origin.says: Simplified from 彌: 弓 (bow) for the meaning plus 爾 (you) as the sound, first a slackened bow, later 'full, to fill'. The simplified form uses 尔 for 爾.

剪.def: scissors; to cut, to divide, to separate

origin.says: 前 (front), the old form for 'to cut', as the sound plus a second 刀 (knife) for the meaning, added once 前 meant 'front': scissors, to cut.

剪.name: scissors

涵.def: to wet, to soak; to tolerate, to include lenient

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 函 (case) as the sound: to soak, to hold water within, hence to contain and to include.

涵.name: soak in

origin.says: 鸟 (bird) for the meaning plus 牙 (tooth) as the sound: a crow. Simplified from 鴉, 鳥 (bird) shortened to 鸟.
𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 文 (pattern) as the sound, a fine red jade, later the rose. The sound part 文 was later written as 攵 (hand with a stick).
From 鹽: 鹵 (salt bag) for the meaning plus 監 (look over) as the sound: salt. The simplified form keeps a shortened top and the 皿 (dish) of 監.
From 蔣: 艹 (grass) for the meaning plus 將 (to take) as the sound: a water grass (wild rice); now mostly a surname. 將 became 将.
𤣩 (jade) for the meaning plus 鬼 (ghost) as the sound: a precious stone, something extraordinary; now mostly in 玫瑰 (rose).

携.def: to carry, to lead, to take by the hand

origin.says: From 攜: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus a sound part, something hanging from the hand. The modern form is a popular simplification that puts 隽 (plump bird) in place of the old sound part.

携.name: carry along

辟.def: law, rule; to open up, to develop

ety.hint: A body 尸 decapitated 口 by a sword 辛 , representing the law

origin.says: Oldest forms show a kneeling person (now 尸, body) and a curved punishing knife (now 辛, bitter/blade), with a ring 口 (mouth) whose role is disputed: punishment, hence law and ruler. The simplified form also took over 闢 (door + 辟: to open up).

辟.name: royal law

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 巽 (to arrange) as the sound: to set in order by hand, to compose and write.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 那 as the sound: graceful; now used mostly in women's names and to spell foreign names like Anna.
木 (wood) for the meaning plus 干 (shield) as the sound: a wooden pole. It also replaced 桿 (木 plus 旱 drought as the sound) in the simplified script.
